messages:
tarnow_sec: Hi team — we got a SIG/Bespoke form due EOD tomorrow and need extra evidence for KMS/HSM usage + audit logs. Also seeing a small spike of 401s in our integration since 03:10 UTC, can you confirm it's not related?

sara_cs: Sorry to hear that — we'll triage. Can you share the exact questionnaire sections that require evidence? Any ticket links? :folded_hands:

tarnow_sec: Sections: Key Management (KMS-2, KMS-4), Audit Logging (LOG-1). They want screenshots + export of audit events for last 30 days and confirmation of HSM-backed key material. Ticket: https://redwood.support/t/4621 (internal)

jordan_se: @sara_cs assigning to me for the 401 repro and log pull. Quick Q: are the 401s from token expiry or auth failures? Any error payload?

tarnow_sec: Error payload from client: `{"error":"unauthorized","message":"token invalid","code":401}`. They happen on token refresh calls and a handful on inference API (`/v1/generate`). Rate ~2/min during window.

jordan_se: Ok. Can you run curl with verbose and paste a single failing request id if available? Also we'll pull auth service logs keyed by the customer org id. For now set `X-Debug-Session: TB-910` on their client so we can correlate.

tarnow_sec: Adding header now. Example failing request id in header: `req_20260317_7a2b4`

opsbot: CI deploy notice: auth-service v2.12.3 deployed to prod at 03:05:12 UTC (sha: 9b7d3a). No rollbacks detected.

mike_security: Noted. HSM/KMS evidence: we can provide key metadata (key IDs, creation/rotation policy), attestation doc for HSM-backed root (FIPS/HSM vendor), and exported audit events. I need to confirm retention window for exported events — default is 90 days in bucket, but we can generate a 30-day export.

sara_cs: Jordan — for the 401s, prioritize: (1) correlate req_20260317_7a2b4 to auth logs, (2) check token issuer service for errors around 03:05-03:20, (3) confirm if deploy at 03:05 could have impacted ephemeral keys.

jordan_se: Triage update: correlated req_20260317_7a2b4 -> auth-service trace id `trace-3f9c`. Trace shows token verification failed due to mismatch of kid header vs current active key. Looks like a short-lived key rotation coinciding with deploy. Extract from trace: 
```
verify_token: failed -> signature mismatch (expected kid: rwd-key-23, found kid: rwd-key-22)
key_rotation: initiated at 03:04:58 UTC
```

jordan_se: So client retried with old token after rotation and got 401 — should be transient. Rate matches. I flagged a note in incident ticket.

tarnow_sec: That explains the 401s, thanks. For the SIG evidence — can you include a note about rotation policy and the short window where old tokens might be rejected? Customer will want deterministic behavior.

mike_security: Agreed. We'll prepare: (a) KMS configuration export (json): key ids, usage policies; (b) HSM attestation pdf (vendor-signed); (c) audit log export: S3 CSV for 2026-02-15 -> 2026-03-17; (d) a short explanation doc on rotation windows and how to handle retries.

opsbot: Export job started: audit-export-1976543210 -> s3://redwood-exports/tarnow/1976543210-audit.csv (status: running)

sara_cs: For SIG/Bespoke form, we need screenshots too. Jordan, can you produce sanitized example logs showing the kid mismatch but redact PII?

jordan_se: Will do. I'll run a redaction script and attach a snippet. Example sanitized line: `2026-03-17T03:06:12Z auth verify fail trace-3f9c kid: rwd-key-22 -> 401`

tarnow_sec: Perfect. One more ask — customer asked for confirmation that log retention meets their policy (min 90 days) and whether we can provide signed timestamps for exported logs.

mike_security: Retention: default 90 days for audit logs, can extend with retention policy for enterprise. We can provide SHA256 checksums for exported CSV and a signed S3 object via presigned URL (checksums + S3 metadata). I'll prepare a short attestation text: `We confirm exported audit logs for TarnowBank cover requested window and are unchanged (sha256: <hash>)` with HSM-signed timestamp if needed.

sara_cs: Great. Action items: Mike -> assemble KMS/HSM artifacts + attestation (ETA 6 hours). Jordan -> sanitized log snippets + brief repro notes (ETA 2 hours). Opsbot -> finish export and provide presigned URL (notify). I'll update the SIG form draft with attachments.

tarnow_sec: Thanks all. Please cc me on the SIG submission. If anything else shows up from our side we'll post here. :pray:

opsbot: Export job complete: s3://redwood-exports/tarnow/1976543210-audit.csv (presigned URL expires 7 days). Checksum: sha256: 3f2b8c9a4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1

jordan_se: Uploaded sanitized snippet and repro notes to the ticket. snippet: `2026-03-17T03:06:12Z auth verify fail trace-3f9c kid: rwd-key-22 -> 401`

mike_security: Uploaded KMS export and HSM attestation. Draft attestation: `Redwood Inference attests that the key material for customer TarnowBank is HSM-backed (vendor: SafeHSM Corp), keys are rotated according to policy every 24 hours for ephemerals and annually for root keys. Export hash: 3f2b8c9a...`.

sara_cs: Closing loop — I'll attach all artifacts to the SIG/Bespoke form and send to Tarnow. Filing internal postmortem note re: rotation timing + deploy to avoid future small windows.

tarnow_sec: Received, appreciate the thoroughness and speed.
